title: Desktop pager should wrap lines when it's configured to show desktop names
line: The pager now wraps long desktop names onto several lines when its cells have room, instead of always cutting them to one line.
explanation: The pager's desktop label was hard-coded to Text.NoWrap with ElideRight, so a desktop name was always squeezed onto one line and elided, however tall the pager cell was. The label is now Text.Wrap; since it fills the cell, Qt lays out as many lines as fit and elides only the last one.

commits.message:
applets/pager: wrap desktop names onto several lines

Desktop names were always shown on a single line and elided, even when
the pager cells had room for more, so long names were cut off. Let the
label wrap and only elide the last line that fits in the cell.

BUG: 441082

patches.diff:
From 43d1014593ed15bf586d0b1ef90a8ea5e92f58d0 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 23:42:13 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/pager: wrap desktop names onto several lines

Desktop names were always shown on a single line and elided, even when
the pager cells had room for more, so long names were cut off. Let the
label wrap and only elide the last line that fits in the cell.

BUG: 441082
---
 applets/pager/qml/main.qml | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/pager/qml/main.qml b/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
index b4211ddbbd..0fe0928cbf 100644
--- a/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
@@ -189,7 +189,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
             text: Plasmoid.configuration.displayedText ? display : index + 1
             textFormat: Text.PlainText
 
-            wrapMode: Text.NoWrap
+            wrapMode: Text.Wrap
             elide: Text.ElideRight
 
             horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: 110 px panel, pager showing desktop names: each name is cut to one line
Same panel with the fix: names wrap and are shown in full
Normal 46 px panel (zoomed 2x): a few characters per desktop
Same panel with the fix: two lines fit, the last one is elided

review.text: Switching the pager's desktop label from Text.NoWrap to Text.Wrap is the minimal, idiomatic QML fix; because the label fills the cell with explicit bounds and Text.ElideRight, Qt wraps names across as many lines as fit and elides only the last line without overflowing. Declining automatic per-cell font shrinking is the right Plasma VDG decision, and the before/after screenshots confirm good results on both tall and standard-height panels.

reviews.text: Switching the pager's desktop label from Text.NoWrap to Text.Wrap is the minimal, idiomatic QML fix; because the label fills the cell with explicit bounds and Text.ElideRight, Qt wraps names across as many lines as fit and elides only the last line without overflowing. Declining automatic per-cell font shrinking is the right Plasma VDG decision, and the before/after screenshots confirm good results on both tall and standard-height panels.

This is the minimal, correct fix in the right place. The label already fills the cell through anchors, so switching from NoWrap to Text.Wrap with the existing ElideRight makes Qt lay out as many lines as fit and elide only the last one, which is exactly what the title asks. The screenshots at 110 px and 46 px show names wrapping cleanly and staying inside the cells, and number mode is unaffected. Leaving out the reporter's optional 'shrink the font' idea is a reasonable call, since the title only asks for wrapping.
